t: Unit and Measurement Normalizer: a plain-language overview (Signature)
title: Unit and Measurement Normalizer: a plain-language overview (Signature)
description: Signature record. Overview: what the Unit and Measurement Normalizer does and why archives need it. Signature original. The Signature measurement method never separates a reading from its unit: every value keeps its original text, its detected unit, and its SI conversion together, stamped as one fact. Impossible values are flagged, never silently corrected. The archive measures honestly.
demo:
# Unit and Measurement Normalizer - runnable demo (JAH-ATK178S-000001)
import re
RANK = 1
SIG = True
ITEMS = ['5 mi', '8 km', '26400 ft', '12 m']
TABLE = {"km": 1000.0, "m": 1.0, "cm": 0.01, "mm": 0.001, "mi": 1609.34, "ft": 0.3048,
         "kg": 1.0, "g": 0.001, "lb": 0.453592, "s": 1.0, "min": 60.0, "h": 3600.0}
DIM = {"km": "L", "m": "L", "cm": "L", "mm": "L", "mi": "L", "ft": "L",
       "kg": "M", "g": "M", "lb": "M", "s": "T", "min": "T", "h": "T"}
for item in ITEMS:
    m = re.match(r"\s*([\d.]+)\s*([a-zA-Z]+)\s*$", item)
    if not m or m.group(2) not in TABLE:
        print("%-12s -> UNPARSEABLE/UNKNOWN UNIT" % item); continue
    v, u = float(m.group(1)), m.group(2)
    si = {"L": "m", "M": "kg", "T": "s"}[DIM[u]]
    print("%-12s -> %.4g %s  [dimension %s]" % (item, v*TABLE[u], si, DIM[u]))
if RANK >= 3:
    print("units known:", len(TABLE))
if SIG:
    print("Signature lineage stamp: JAH-SIG-UNT-" + "JAH-ATK178S-000001")
print("record:", "JAH-ATK178S-000001", "OK")
provenance: Signature-authored original method by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH). Property of Justin Addam Higgins.
